收白龙马
《西游记》之六
原著 吴承恩
改编 张帆

轩觀

河北美术出版社
内容提要
唐僧在两界山收了孙悟空，来到蛇盘山鹰愁涧。涧里
有一条白龙，吞吃了唐僧的白马。孙悟空向白龙讨要白马，
白龙却变作水蛇逃走了。没有白马，师父如何西行？后来，
土地和天神帮助孙悟空请来了观音菩萨，这才收了白龙变
成的白龙马。唐僧师徒二人继续西行取经去了。
page_text_en:
Taming the White Dragon Horse
Part Six of "Journey to the West"
Original Author: Wu Cheng'en
Adapted by: Zhang Fan
Illustrated by: Zhang Lushan
Xuan Guan
Yin Chao
Hebei Fine Arts Publishing House
Synopsis
Tang Sanzang tamed Sun Wukong at Liangjie Mountain and arrived at the Eagle-Sorrow Gorge on Snake-Coiled Mountain. In the gorge, there was a white dragon who swallowed Tang Sanzang's white horse. Sun Wukong demanded the horse back from the white dragon, but the dragon transformed into a water snake and fled. Without the white horse, how could the master journey west? Later, the Earth God and heavenly deities helped Sun Wukong summon Guanyin Bodhisattva, who finally tamed the white dragon and transformed him into the White Dragon Horse. Tang Sanzang and his disciple continued their journey westward to fetch the scriptures.
summary_zh: 本页为《西游记》连环画第六册的扉页，包含书名、作者、出版社信息及内容提要，简述了唐僧师徒在蛇盘山鹰愁涧收服白龙马的故事情节。

1 唐僧在两界山收了孙悟空，师徒二人继续西进。
2 这天来到一座山前，唐僧在马上听见哗啦啦的流水声，回头问悟空：‘这是哪里水响？’悟空道：‘我记得这地方叫蛇盘山鹰愁涧，大概是涧里水响。’
page_text_en:
1 Tang Sanzang recruited Sun Wukong at Liangjie Mountain, and the master and disciple continued westward.
2 That day, they arrived at the foot of a mountain. Tang Sanzang, riding on horseback, heard the gurgling sound of flowing water and turned to ask Wukong: 'Where is this water coming from?' Wukong replied: 'I remember this place is called Shepan Mountain, Yingchou Gorge. It's probably the water from the gorge.'
summary_zh: 本页描绘了唐僧与孙悟空师徒二人西行途中，来到蛇盘山鹰愁涧，唐僧听见流水声并询问孙悟空，孙悟空告知此处地名的情节。

3 唐僧策马来到涧边，但见：山上崖险，碧水东流。师徒二人正在观看，只听得“轰隆”一声巨响，波浪掀天，从涧中钻出一条白龙，直向唐僧扑来。
4 悟空见这情形，慌忙丢了行李，从马上背起师父就跑。这白龙追不到唐僧，转身便把唐僧的白马连鞍辔一口吞下肚去。
page_text_en:
3 Tang Sanzang rode his horse to the edge of the ravine, where he saw: steep cliffs on the mountain, and clear water flowing eastward. The master and disciple were watching when suddenly a loud 'boom' echoed, waves surged skyward, and a white dragon emerged from the ravine, charging straight at Tang Sanzang.
4 Wukong, seeing this, hastily dropped his luggage, lifted his master onto his back, and ran away. The white dragon, unable to catch Tang Sanzang, turned around and swallowed Tang Sanzang's white horse, along with its saddle and bridle, in one gulp.
summary_zh: 唐僧师徒来到鹰愁涧边，一条白龙从涧中跃出扑向唐僧，孙悟空背起师父逃跑，白龙则将唐僧的白马连同鞍辔吞下。

5 等悟空把师父送在山腰上坐了，回来牵马挑担，却只找到了行李，不见了马匹，四处寻找，也不见踪影。
6 悟空把行李担到师父面前说：‘师父，那孽龙逃了，把我们的马也惊走了。’唐僧道：‘这……这还能找得到吗？’悟空道：‘师父放心，等我再去看看。’
page_text_en:
5 After Wukong had carried his master to sit on a hillside, he returned to lead the horse and carry the luggage, but only found the luggage, not the horse. He searched everywhere but found no trace.
6 Wukong brought the luggage to his master and said, 'Master, that demon dragon has escaped and frightened away our horse.' Tang僧 said, 'This... can we still find it?' Wukong said, 'Master, don't worry, I'll go check again.'
summary_zh: 孙悟空将唐僧安置在山腰后，回来发现白马失踪，只找到行李。他向唐僧报告白龙逃走并惊走了马，唐僧担忧，孙悟空表示会再去查看。

7 悟空打了个唿哨，跳在空中，手搭凉篷，睁圆火眼金睛，四下里观看，还是看不见马的踪影。
8 悟空按落云头，告诉唐僧说，那马可能被那孽龙吃了。唐僧着急道：“这马若被它吃了，我如何前进！可怜啊！这千山万水，怎么走啊！”说着，不由得泪如雨下。
page_text_en:
7 Wukong whistled, jumped into the air, shaded his eyes with his hand, opened his fiery golden eyes wide, and looked around in all directions, but still could not see any trace of the horse.
8 Wukong landed from the clouds and told Master Tang that the horse might have been eaten by that evil dragon. Master Tang anxiously said, "If this horse is eaten by it, how can I proceed! Poor me! How can I travel across these thousands of mountains and rivers!" Saying this, he couldn't help but shed tears like rain.
summary_zh: 孙悟空腾空寻找白马未果，落地后告知唐僧白马可能被孽龙吃掉，唐僧因此焦急落泪。

9 悟空见他哭了起来，哪里忍得住暴躁，喊道：“师父莫要这样脓包！你坐着，等老孙去寻找那厮，叫他还我们的马匹便了！”说罢便要前去。
10 唐僧连忙上前拉住悟空说：“啊呀，徒弟呀！你若是去了，那龙要是暗地里蹿出来，岂不连我都害了？那时候人马两亡，可怎么办哪！”
page_text_en:
9 Wukong saw him crying and, unable to hold back his anger, shouted, “Master, don’t be such a coward! Sit still and let me go find that fellow and make him return our horse!” Saying this, he was about to go.
10 Tang Sanzang hurriedly stepped forward and held Wukong, saying, “Ah, my disciple! If you go, and that dragon suddenly jumps out from hiding, won’t it harm me too? Then we’d both be lost—what would we do?”
summary_zh: 孙悟空见唐僧因白马被吞而哭泣，怒不可遏，欲去寻白龙马报仇；唐僧急忙拉住他，担心他独自前去会遭遇危险，导致人马俱亡。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf

11 悟空听了，叫道：“师父太不思事了，又要骑马，又不放我去。我们就这样等到老吧！”他又一想，说道：“也罢，待老孙叫几个天兵天将来保护你吧。”
12 悟空念动真言，不大一会儿，就请来了天兵天将。悟空请他们保护唐僧，众神连连答应。
page_text_en:
11 Wukong heard this and shouted, “Master, you’re being unreasonable! You want to ride the horse, yet you won’t let me go. Let’s just wait here until we’re old!” He thought for a moment and said, “Well then, I’ll call a few heavenly soldiers and generals to protect you.”
12 Wukong chanted the true words, and in no time, he summoned the heavenly soldiers and generals. Wukong asked them to protect Tang Sanzang, and the gods readily agreed.
summary_zh: 孙悟空因唐僧不让他去找白龙马而生气，决定请天兵天将保护师父。他念动真言后，天兵天将现身，答应保护唐僧。

13 悟空把唐僧交与天兵天将后，身子一纵，来到涧上，抡开金箍棒，高声骂道：“泼泥鳅，快还我马来！快还我马来！”
14 却说那条龙吃了唐僧的白马，伏在涧底正在休息。只听得有人叫骂，他按不住心头怒火，纵身跳上来说道：“是哪个大胆狂徒，敢在这里骂我！”
page_text_en:
13 After handing Tang Sanzang over to the heavenly soldiers and generals, Wukong leaped to the edge of the ravine, brandished his golden cudgel, and shouted angrily: "You filthy mudfish, return my horse! Return my horse!"
14 Meanwhile, the dragon who had eaten Tang Sanzang's white horse was resting at the bottom of the ravine. Hearing someone shouting insults, he could no longer contain his rage, leaped up, and said: "Who is this bold rascal daring to insult me here!"
summary_zh: 孙悟空将唐僧托付给天兵天将后，独自来到鹰愁涧边，怒骂白龙马，要求其归还白马；白龙马在涧底休息时听到骂声，勃然大怒，跳上水面质问是谁敢骂它。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf

15 悟空见他上来，大叫一声：‘休走！还我马来！’说时
抡棍劈头就打。那龙也不相让，张牙舞爪直向悟空扑来。
16 战有三十回合，那条龙渐渐力软筋麻，打一个转身，
蹿入水中，藏在涧底，再不出来了。
page_text_en:
15 Wukong saw him coming up and shouted, 'Stop! Return my horse!' At that moment, he swung his staff and struck down. The dragon did not yield, but opened its jaws and claws, rushing straight at Wukong.
16 After thirty rounds of battle, the dragon gradually grew weak and tired, turned around, dived into the water, hid at the bottom of the ravine, and did not come out again.
summary_zh: 孙悟空与白龙马在鹰愁涧展开激战，孙悟空怒斥白龙马归还白马，双方激烈交锋三十回合后，白龙马力竭退入水中藏匿。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
17 悟空在涧上叫骂了好长时候，也不见那龙出来。没奈何，便回来对唐僧道：‘师父，我向那孽龙去讨要马匹，和他战了一场，被我打得逃进水中，再不敢出来了。’
18 唐僧说：‘你前日打虎的时候，曾说有降龙伏虎的本领，今日怎么便不能降他？’悟空吃不得人激他，听师父抢白了他几句，他就发起脾气来，说道：‘不要说！不要说！等我与他再见个上下！’
page_text_en:
17 Wukong shouted insults at the ravine for a long time, but the dragon did not come out. Helpless, he returned to Tang Sanzang and said, 'Master, I went to demand the horse from that evil dragon, fought him, and beat him into fleeing into the water. He dares not come out anymore.'
18 Tang Sanzang said, 'When you killed the tiger the other day, you said you had the ability to subdue dragons and tigers. Why can't you subdue him today?' Wukong could not stand being provoked. After hearing his master scold him a few times, he became angry and said, 'Don't say it! Don't say it! Let me settle things with him once and for all!'
summary_zh: 孙悟空在鹰愁涧边叫骂白龙马未果，返回向唐僧报告已将其打退入水；唐僧质疑其降龙本领，孙悟空被激怒，决心再次与白龙马决一死战。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
19 这猴王，又跳到涧边，使出翻江搅海的神通，用铁棒把鹰愁涧的水，搅得像开了锅似的乱滚。
20 那龙在深涧中，坐卧不宁，很是恼怒，便跳出来，骂道：“你是哪里来的泼魔，这样欺负我！”悟空道：“你别管，你先还我的马来！”说着，抡棍就打。
page_text_en:
19 The Monkey King jumped to the edge of the ravine again, using his divine power to stir the waters of Eagle-Sorrow Ravine with his iron staff, churning them like a boiling pot.
20 The dragon, restless and furious in the deep ravine, jumped out and shouted, "Who are you, you rascal, to bully me like this!" Wukong replied, "Don't worry about that, just return my horse first!" Saying this, he swung his staff and attacked.
summary_zh: 孙悟空再次来到鹰愁涧边，用金箍棒搅动涧水，白龙马因受扰而跳出来，双方再次对峙并展开激战。

source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf

21 他两个在山崖下又恶斗起来。那龙打不过悟空，将身一晃，变作一条水蛇儿，钻入乱草中去了。
22 悟空抡着棍，赶上前來，拨草寻找，怎么也找不到那蛇的踪影。
page_text_en:
21 The two of them fought fiercely again at the foot of the cliff. The dragon, unable to defeat Wukong, flicked his body and transformed into a water snake, then darted into the tangled grass.
22 Wukong, swinging his staff, rushed forward and searched through the grass, but could not find any trace of the snake.
summary_zh: 孙悟空与白龙马在山崖下再次激战，白龙马不敌变作水蛇钻入草中，孙悟空随后拨草寻找却未找到其踪迹。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf

23 悟空急得三神暴跳，七窍生烟，念了一声咒语，便唤来当地的土地、山神。悟空叫道：“鹰愁涧里是什么妖怪，敢吃了我师父的白马？
24 山神和土地连忙施礼说道：“这涧中向来无邪。只是前几年菩萨救了一条玉龙，送他在此。叫他等候取经人，不许为非作歹，不想今日冲撞了大圣。”
page_text_en:
23 Wukong, furious and frantic, jumped up and down, his seven orifices smoking, and chanted a spell, summoning the local Earth God and Mountain God. Wukong shouted: “What monster is in Eagle-Sorrow Gorge, daring to eat my master’s white horse?
24 The Mountain God and Earth God hurriedly bowed and said: “This gorge has always been free of evil. It was only a few years ago that the Bodhisattva rescued a jade dragon and sent him here, instructing him to wait for the scripture-fetcher and not to do any wrong, but today he accidentally offended the Great Sage.”
summary_zh: 孙悟空因白马被吃而愤怒，召唤土地和山神询问真相；山神和土地解释，鹰愁涧中的玉龙是菩萨所救，奉命等候取经人，今日无意冲撞了孙悟空。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
25 悟空要土地、山神去把那龙找来，土地说：‘大圣不知，这条涧千万个洞涧相通，他钻进去了，怎么能找到呢？大圣不必发怒，要擒此龙，只要请观世音来，自然能降伏他。’
26 悟空觉得这话有道理，便叫土地、山神，同来见了唐僧，悟空要师父在这里等候，自己往南海去请观音菩萨。
page_text_en:
25 Wukong asked the Land God and Mountain God to find that dragon. The Land God said, 'Great Sage, you don't know. This ravine has countless interconnected caves. Once he has钻进去, how can we find him? Great Sage, don't be angry. To capture this dragon, just invite Guanyin. She will naturally subdue him.'
26 Wukong thought this made sense. He called the Land God and Mountain God, and together they went to see Master Tang. Wukong told his master to wait there while he went to the South Sea to invite Guanyin Bodhisattva.
summary_zh: 孙悟空向土地和山神询问如何找到白龙马，土地建议请观音菩萨降伏；孙悟空认为有理，便带土地和山神去见唐僧，决定独自前往南海请观音菩萨。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
27 唐僧说:“慢来！慢来！你若去请菩萨，什么时候才能回来？我在这里受饥寒由谁来管。”话还没有说完，只听得空中有天神道：“大圣不必去了，小神去请菩萨。”
28 悟空大喜，连说：“有累，有累！快去快回！”那天神纵云头，往南海去了。悟空吩咐山神、土地守护唐僧，并找来食物让唐僧用过斋饭。他就又到涧边找那孽龙去了。
page_text_en:
27 Tang Sanzang said: "Slow down! Slow down! If you go to invite the Bodhisattva, when will you return? Who will take care of me while I suffer from hunger and cold here?" Before he could finish speaking, a heavenly deity was heard from the sky: "Great Sage, you need not go. I will go to invite the Bodhisattva." 
28 Wukong was overjoyed and said: "You are so kind, so kind! Go quickly and return quickly!" The heavenly deity then soared on clouds toward the South Sea. Wukong instructed the mountain deity and the land god to protect Tang Sanzang, and brought food for Tang Sanzang to eat. Then he went back to the ravine to look for that demon dragon.
summary_zh: 唐僧担心孙悟空去请菩萨会耽误自己，天神主动提出代为前往；孙悟空大喜，吩咐山神土地守护唐僧并安排其饮食后，又返回鹰愁涧寻找白龙马。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
29 却说那位天神来到南海，见了菩萨，细说来意。菩萨说道：‘这龙是西海龙王的儿子，曾犯死罪。是我保了他，叫他给唐僧做个脚力，怎么他却吃了唐僧的马匹？这样说，我倒要去看看是怎么回事。’
30 菩萨走下莲台，与那天神驾了祥云，离开南海，直往蛇盘山奔来。
page_text_en:
29 The heavenly deity arrived at the South Sea and met the Bodhisattva, explaining the situation. The Bodhisattva said: 'This dragon is the son of the West Sea Dragon King, who once committed a capital crime. I saved him and asked him to serve as a steed for Master Tang. How could he then eat Master Tang's horse? If that's true, I must go and see what's going on.'
30 The Bodhisattva descended from the lotus throne, rode the auspicious cloud with the heavenly deity, left the South Sea, and headed straight for Shepan Mountain.
summary_zh: 天神向观音菩萨说明白龙马吃马之事，菩萨得知后决定亲自前往查看。随后，菩萨与天神驾云离开南海，直奔蛇盘山。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
31 不大一会儿，菩萨与天神来到蛇盘山。只见悟空正在涧边叫骂。菩萨让天神叫他来。那天神直到涧边，对悟空说：‘大圣，菩萨来了，在空中等你。’
32 悟空见了菩萨，大叫道：‘你这个慈悲的观世音！既放我出来，就该让我自在逍遥，却为什么弄个紧箍儿害我！如今又放纵孽龙，吃了我师父的马匹，你可把我给害苦了！’
page_text_en:
31 After a short while, the Bodhisattva and the heavenly deity arrived at Shepan Mountain. They saw Wukong shouting angrily by the ravine. The Bodhisattva asked the deity to call him over. The deity went to the ravine and said to Wukong, 'Great Sage, the Bodhisattva has arrived and is waiting for you in the air.'
32 When Wukong saw the Bodhisattva, he shouted, 'You compassionate Guanyin! After releasing me, you should have let me live freely and carefree. Why did you put this tight-fitting headband on me to harm me? And now you've let the evil dragon run loose and eaten my master's horse. You've really made me suffer!'
summary_zh: 菩萨与天神抵达蛇盘山，天神告知孙悟空菩萨已到；孙悟空见到菩萨后，愤怒指责其用紧箍咒束缚自己，并抱怨菩萨放纵白龙马吃掉师父的马匹。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
33 菩萨道：‘你这猴子，救了你的性命，不来谢恩，反而胡闹！如果没有点儿管教，再闯出祸来，谁能管你？那条龙，是我叫他在此，专为给你师父做脚力的。你师父的凡马哪能到西天？’
34 悟空说那条龙藏起来找不见了。菩萨说：‘不妨，你去涧边叫一声“敖闰龙王三太子你出来，有南海菩萨在此。”他就出来了。’
page_text_en:
33 The Bodhisattva said: 'You monkey, I saved your life, yet you don't come to thank me, but instead cause trouble! If I don't discipline you a bit, and you cause more trouble, who will manage you? That dragon is here at my command, specifically to serve as your master's steed. How could your master's ordinary horse ever reach the Western Heaven?'
34 Wukong said the dragon had hidden and could not be found. The Bodhisattva said: 'Don't worry, go to the ravine and call out, "Ao Run, Prince of the Dragon King, come out! The Bodhisattva of the South Sea is here." He will come out.'
summary_zh: 观音菩萨到达鹰愁涧，面对孙悟空的指责，解释白龙马是她安排来为唐僧做脚力的，并让孙悟空去涧边呼唤白龙马现身。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
35 悟空来到涧边叫了两遍，那龙果然翻波跃浪，跳了出来。
36 那龙变成人形，踏了云头，到空中对菩萨礼拜道：
“蒙菩萨救命之恩，在此等了很久，始终不见取经人到来。”
page_text_en:
35 Wukong came to the edge of the ravine and called out twice. The dragon indeed churned the waves and leapt out.
36 The dragon transformed into human form, stepped onto the clouds, and bowed to the Bodhisattva in the air, saying:
"Grateful for your life-saving kindness, I have waited here for a long time, but have never seen the scripture-fetcher arrive."
summary_zh: 孙悟空在涧边呼唤，白龙马从水中跃出；随后白龙马化为人形，向观音菩萨行礼，诉说已等候取经人多时却未见其到来。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
37 菩萨指着悟空说：‘这就是取经人的大徒弟。’那龙说悟空并没有说过他是取经人；菩萨说：‘你这猴头，专倚自强，以后还有归顺的哩。再有人问，就先提起‘取经’的事来。’
38 悟空喜欢领教。菩萨上前，把那龙项下的明珠摘了，用杨柳枝沾上甘露，往他身上一洒，吹了口法气，喝一声‘变！’那龙就变成了一匹白马。
page_text_en:
37 The Bodhisattva pointed at Wukong and said, 'This is the great disciple of the scripture-fetcher.' The dragon said Wukong had never said he was the scripture-fetcher; the Bodhisattva said, 'You monkey, relying on your own strength, will still submit in the future. When others ask, mention the matter of 'fetching scriptures' first.'
38 Wukong was pleased to receive the instruction. The Bodhisattva stepped forward, removed the pearl from the dragon's neck, dipped the willow branch in sweet dew, sprinkled it on the dragon, blew a breath of magic, and shouted, 'Change!' The dragon then turned into a white horse.
summary_zh: 观音菩萨向白龙马介绍孙悟空是取经人的大徒弟，并教导他今后要以取经为由；随后菩萨用法力将白龙马变为白马。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
39 菩萨又嘱咐龙马要好好保唐僧取经，那龙马连连点头答应。菩萨叫悟空牵了龙马去见唐僧。悟空却说：‘我不保唐僧去西天了，路途这样难走，什么时候才能走到，我不去了！’
40 菩萨道：‘你初生时，倒肯苦钻苦学；怎么如今倒怕起难来了呢？假如再遇困难，我许你叫天天应，叫地地灵。如果十分艰难时，我就亲自来救你。你过来，我再赠你一点本事。’
page_text_en:
39 The Bodhisattva again instructed the dragon horse to protect Master Tang on his journey to fetch scriptures, and the dragon horse nodded repeatedly in agreement. The Bodhisattva told Wukong to lead the dragon horse to meet Master Tang. Wukong replied: 'I won't protect Master Tang to the West anymore. The journey is so difficult; when will we ever arrive? I'm not going!'
40 The Bodhisattva said: 'When you were first born, you were willing to study hard; how come now you're afraid of difficulties? If you encounter trouble again, I promise you can call out to heaven and it will respond, call out to earth and it will answer. If it becomes extremely difficult, I will come to save you myself. Come here, and I will grant you a little more skill.'
summary_zh: 观音菩萨嘱咐白龙马保护唐僧取经，并让孙悟空牵马去见唐僧，孙悟空因路途艰难而拒绝；菩萨安慰孙悟空，承诺在危难时会亲自相救，并要传授他新的本事。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
41 悟空走近。菩萨把杨柳叶儿，摘下三个，放在悟空的脑后，喝声“变！”即变做三根救命毫毛。说道：“你若遇到大灾大难的时候，可以随机应变，救你脱出急苦灾难。”
42 悟空受了这番鼓励，才坚定了去西天的决心。那菩萨驾起祥云，回转南海去了。
page_text_en:
41 Wukong approached. The Bodhisattva plucked three willow leaves, placed them behind Wukong's head, and shouted, "Change!" They instantly turned into three life-saving hairs. She said, "When you encounter great disasters, you can adapt as needed and save yourself from urgent hardships and calamities." 
42 Wukong, encouraged by these words, finally resolved to go to the West. The Bodhisattva then mounted her auspicious cloud and returned to the South Sea.
summary_zh: 观音菩萨赐予孙悟空三根救命毫毛，并鼓励他坚定西行决心；随后菩萨驾云返回南海，孙悟空骑马踏上取经之路。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
43 悟空揪了那龙马的顶鬃，来见唐僧。唐僧一见大喜道：‘徒弟，怎么这匹马比以前肥了？’悟空说：‘师父，你还做梦哩，这是菩萨把那条龙变成这一匹白马的。’
44 唐僧大惊道：‘菩萨在哪？我去拜谢他。’悟空道：‘菩萨这时候早已回到南海去了。’唐僧就地堆土焚香，望南礼拜。
page_text_en:
43 Wukong grabbed the horse's mane and came to see Tang Sanzang. Tang Sanzang was delighted and said, 'Disciple, how come this horse is fatter than before?' Wukong replied, 'Master, you're still dreaming. This is the Bodhisattva who turned that dragon into this white horse.'
44 Tang Sanzang was startled and said, 'Where is the Bodhisattva? I must go thank him.' Wukong said, 'The Bodhisattva has already returned to the South Sea.' Tang Sanzang then piled up earth, burned incense, and bowed southward.
summary_zh: 孙悟空牵着由白龙马变化而来的白马去见唐僧，唐僧见马变肥而惊讶，孙悟空解释是菩萨所为。唐僧想感谢菩萨，但得知菩萨已回南海，便就地焚香朝南礼拜。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
45 悟空收拾好行李，拜谢了山神、土地和天兵天将，请师父骑上龙马，渡过了鹰愁涧。
46 师徒二人一路行来，不觉红日西沉，天色渐晚。来到一座庙前，二人要在此借宿一夜。唐僧让悟空前去叫门，不一会从门里走出一个老者，让他们进庙内歇息。
page_text_en:
45 Wukong packed up the luggage, thanked the mountain god, land god, and heavenly soldiers and generals, and asked his master to ride the dragon horse, crossing the Eagle-Sorrow Gorge.
46 The master and disciple traveled along, unaware that the sun had set and dusk was falling. They arrived at a temple, intending to stay overnight. Tang僧 asked Wukong to go knock on the door. Soon, an old man came out of the door and invited them to rest inside the temple.
summary_zh: 孙悟空收拾行李，拜谢神灵后，请唐僧骑上龙马渡过鹰愁涧；师徒二人行至傍晚，来到一座庙前借宿，唐僧让孙悟空叫门，一位老者开门让他们进庙歇息。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
47 老者叫童子献过茶，问明唐僧是大唐派往西天取经的圣僧，很是欢喜。便又忙叫童子赶办斋饭。
48 吃饭间，那老者问起唐僧骑的马匹为什么没有鞍辔，唐僧把这马的来历说了一番。那老者道：“正好我这里有一副鞍辔，愿送给师父使用。”唐僧忙起身拜谢。
page_text_en:
47 The old man called his attendant to serve tea, learned that Tang Sanzang was a holy monk sent by the Tang Dynasty to fetch scriptures from the West, and was very pleased. He then hurriedly ordered the attendant to prepare a vegetarian meal.
48 During the meal, the old man asked why the horse Tang Sanzang was riding had no saddle or bridle. Tang Sanzang explained the horse's origin. The old man said, "Fortunately, I have a set of saddle and bridle here. I am willing to give them to you, Master." Tang Sanzang quickly rose to thank him.
summary_zh: 师徒二人在庙中借宿，老者得知唐僧是取经人后十分欢喜，准备斋饭款待。吃饭时，老者见唐僧的马无鞍辔，便主动赠送一副鞍辔，唐僧连忙拜谢。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
49 第二天早晨，师徒二人准备起程。那老者果然拿来了一副鞍辔和缰笼等物，凡是马上用的东西，无不全备。悟空将鞍辔戴在马上，就好像是给这匹马量着做的一样。
50 龙马有了鞍辔，唐僧师徒很是欢喜，赶忙拜谢那长老。正在这时，忽然金光一闪，却不见了长老，也不见了庙宇。眼前变成了一片空地。
page_text_en:
49 The next morning, the master and disciple prepared to set out. The old man indeed brought a set of saddle, bridle, and other horse gear; everything needed for the horse was fully provided. Wukong put the saddle on the horse, which seemed to be custom-made for the horse.
50 With the saddle on the dragon horse, Tang Sanzang and his disciple were very happy and hurriedly bowed to thank the old man. Just then, a flash of golden light appeared, and the old man and the temple vanished. Before them was now an empty field.
summary_zh: 第二天早晨，老者为唐僧师徒送来鞍辔等马具，悟空为马装上鞍辔。师徒二人感谢老者时，金光一闪，老者和庙宇消失，眼前变成一片空地。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
51 师徒二人正在奇怪，只听空中有人说道：‘我们是菩萨差来送鞍辔的，你们要努力西行，不可怠慢。’慌得唐僧忙跪在地上，望空拜道：‘多蒙菩萨保祐，多蒙菩萨保祐。’
52 你看唐僧只管朝天磕头，也不计其数。路旁活活地笑倒孙大圣，他上前忙扯住唐僧说：‘师父，快起来吧，人家早走远啦，你只管拜个没完做什么？’
page_text_en:
51 The master and disciple were puzzled when they heard someone in the sky say: 'We are sent by the Bodhisattva to deliver the saddle and bridle. You must strive to journey westward, without delay.' Startled, Tang Sanzang knelt on the ground and bowed to the sky, saying: 'Many thanks to the Bodhisattva for your protection, many thanks to the Bodhisattva for your protection.'
52 Look, Tang Sanzang kept bowing his head to the sky, counting not a single time. Sun Wukong laughed heartily beside the road, and hurriedly pulled Tang Sanzang up, saying: 'Master, get up quickly! They've already gone far away. Why are you bowing endlessly?'
summary_zh: 师徒二人在空地发现马具后，空中传来菩萨使者的声音，唐僧连忙跪拜，孙悟空则笑着劝他起身，因使者已远去。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》
title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 06: Taming the White Dragon Horse'
source_file: 连环画《西游记06：收白龙马》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
53 唐僧道：‘为师在这里磕头，你也不拜一拜，站在一边只是笑个没完，是什么道理？’悟空道：‘俺老孙自小儿做好汉，不晓得拜人，就是见了玉皇大帝，我也只是招呼一声儿。’
54 唐僧起得身来，要悟空少说闲话，赶快收拾起程。师徒二人收拾停当，又往西方赶路去了。欲知后事如何，请看第七册《黑风山》。
page_text_en:
53 Tang Sanzang said: 'Master is bowing here, and you don't even bow once, just standing aside laughing endlessly. What's the reason?' Wukong said: 'I've been a good fellow since childhood, I don't know how to bow to anyone. Even if I meet the Jade Emperor, I'd just greet him with a word.'
54 Tang Sanzang stood up and told Wukong to stop talking nonsense and hurry to pack up and set off. The master and disciple finished packing and headed westward again. To know what happens next, please read Volume 7, 'Black Wind Mountain.'
summary_zh: 唐僧因菩萨使者离去而跪拜，孙悟空在一旁笑而不拜，解释自己向来不习惯行礼；随后唐僧起身催促孙悟空收拾行装，师徒二人继续西行。
